commitIdContract.usageNote: 40-character hexadecimal identifier-format validation only (ADO commit IDs). Never used for any cryptographic guarantee.

branchPolicy.note: Requires the Azure DevOps branch policy 'Reset code reviewer votes when new changes are pushed' to be enabled on repository.targetBranchRef. When -EnableApprovalVote is used, the wrapper independently re-reads tracked approvals through Agency ADO MCP and fails closed (refuses to sign off / requires manual verification) if it cannot prove a stale approval was actually reset by this policy.

teamsNotifications.note: Checked-in config alone NEVER enables Teams writes. The operator must also pass -EnableTeamsNotifications. Safe/disabled until teamId/channelId are intentionally populated. Webhook URLs/secrets are never stored here - only the NAME of an environment variable that holds one at runtime.

workflowsWebhook.note: Channel fallback only, never used for author DMs. Legacy Office 365 Connector webhooks are retired/unsupported; only a Teams Workflows (Power Automate) webhook host is accepted.

guidanceCommands.description: Full API Hub build, tests skipped (see AGENTS.md Build Quick Reference)
